body:
Fixes #2745.

Codex exited 137 during a Rust build, but its result dropped the process status and had an empty error summary. Users consequently saw only `CODEX execution failed`, and the existing SIGKILL recovery gate could not recognize the termination.

The adapter now preserves exit code/signal, logs and returns an actionable process error, and reports fresh OOM evidence from comparable before/after cgroup snapshots. Missing or stale counters retain an unknown-cause diagnosis. Plain CLI stderr errors survive chunk splitting; structured Codex errors keep priority and telemetry echoes remain excluded. Signal exits cannot be mistaken for a quoted provider limit in the last command output.

Codex also receives its actual container memory budget and guidance to run memory-heavy builds sequentially, prefer focused targets, and use adequately provisioned CI when a compiler cannot fit. This restores existing recovery eligibility; it does not add a new retry policy or guarantee that an oversized build will fit.

The [case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/tree/issue-2745-0f09e2e55406/docs/case-studies/issue-2745) preserves the complete incident, prior attempt, discussions, checksums, timeline, primary-source research and validation evidence. The incident records a 2.92 GiB cgroup limit, 23 cumulative OOM kills, and overlapping Cargo builds. Kernel victim attribution is unavailable. [Router #745](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/issues/745) contains the bounded compilation recipe, demonstrated workarounds and proposed build changes.

Reproduce without a live model or memory stress:

```bash
node --test tests/codex-process-exit-2745.test.mjs tests/codex-process-diagnostics.test.mjs
```

The original replay failed 11 assertions before the fix. All 17 final focused tests pass, covering process status, failure publication, kill recovery eligibility, fresh/stale counters, stderr framing/precedence, successful turns, budget guidance and the retained 1 MiB final-message cap. Includes a patch Changeset and the default-branch merge.

Box 2.10.3 was released during final validation and made all three image pins stale. The pins, language-catalog base and active verification defaults now match that release. The complete CI and local freshness failures are preserved in the case study. Both regular and DinD manifests include Linux amd64 and arm64 images.

Local validation: all 580 default test files, both GitHub integration files, lint, formatting, duplication, secrets, syntax, line limits, documentation, memory smoke, patch Changeset validation and dependency freshness (168/168 current). All 580 default files and the affected quality checks passed again after the Box refresh; its five existing pin/image files plus 17 diagnostics cases pass together. The cancellation probe is independent of host cgroup data; all 42 combined automation/diagnostic tests pass.

Implementation CI passed on `ed3cd509`: Checks and release (all 580 default files and both GitHub integration files), Security, Broken Link Checker, and the checks-only Workflows dispatch. Their complete logs and exact-SHA metadata are archived in the case study. Publication CI passed on final commit `2e892c7b8ef7c786b8b15fc8f2d1cc2a7a63d4a2` (committed 2026-10-08 10:17:36 UTC). All runs below began afterward and report that exact SHA:

- [Checks and release](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37762534351): all 580 default test files, both GitHub integration files, lint, documentation, memory/execution checks, both Docker image builds and running-container/nested-Docker verification passed. Pipeline Status reports no failed or cancelled jobs.
- [Security](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37762533234): passed.
- [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37762533246): passed.
- [Workflows, checks-only dispatch](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37762574534): passed.

The final PR check inventory contains 19 successful checks and 14 legitimately skipped release/unaffected jobs. Main is merged, and the working tree is clean.
title: fix(codex): report process failures and container OOM evidence
